InfoItems.Info: Fixture has On Off switch on base of fixture Ch 6 - Lamp needs 5 minutes to cool after switching off. Lamp will not switch on within this time, but any lamp on command will be saved and execued when the time is over. Ch 6 DMX 230-239 - Select Lamp Off via DMX to enable Lamp Off control via DMX Weight for fixture with electromagnetic ballast. Channel 14, 16 has more than one mode condition which is not supported.
